name: GetSiteByPath
description: Retrieves details of a SharePoint site by its URL or path using Microsoft Graph.
author: @rahmat

fields.name: __CredentialId__M365
fields.label: M365 Credential
fields.description: Select the Microsoft 365 credential used to authenticate the request.

fields.name: SitePath
fields.label: Site URL
fields.description: The URL or path of the SharePoint site you want to retrieve details for. For example: /sites/YourSite or https://contoso.sharepoint.com/sites/YourSite

fields.name: Result
fields.label: Result
fields.description: The result of the site retrieval operation, including site details and any error messages.
